release_route: presidio-extras/v0.1.0 -> GitHub Actions trusted publishing -> PyPI
scope: Extracts the opt-in Jev Presidio context filter out of the pleno-anonymize SDK into a standalone optional package. No NER model or training change. No production accuracy, recall, calibration, or latency claim.

validation.build: wheel and sdist byte-reproducible across rebuilds; root .gitignore in sdist and missing LICENSE are pre-existing repo-wide hatchling behaviour, deferred
validation.moved_code_identity: git show 1873267^:packages/sdk/src/pleno_anonymize/presidio.py | diff - packages/presidio-extras/src/pleno_presidio_extras/jev.py => logger name only

findings.claim: The release claims model-quality experimental metrics.
findings.evidence: `git diff a4d2851 HEAD -- packages/models/ packages/training/` => empty (exit 0); packages/presidio-extras/README.md:86-87 'candidate-level integration smoke test, not a NER precision/recall benchmark'; no Jev experiment row in packages/training/experiments/log.jsonl or best.json.
findings.conclusion: N/A. No model or training change; Jev claims no model-quality metric (opt-in Presidio post-processing layer).

findings.claim: Baseline comparison validity (sdk/v0.3.0 -> pleno-presidio-extras 0.1.0 is a pure move).
findings.evidence: `git show sdk/v0.3.0:packages/sdk/src/pleno_anonymize/presidio.py | diff - packages/presidio-extras/src/pleno_presidio_extras/jev.py` => line 16 logger name only; test and script diffs are import lines only.
findings.conclusion: No problem. Moved code is byte-identical to the published tag except the logger name; no before/after NER metric comparison exists.

findings.claim: Statistical significance (F1/CI/test).
findings.evidence: README:72-74 and :86-87 disclaim calibration and benchmark status; smoke artifacts recomputed: 9/9 retention, 2/6 and 3/6 false-positive removal. `pytest -q` => 43 passed.
findings.conclusion: N/A. No F1, confidence interval, or significance claim; the smoke is n=15 hand-written synthetic candidates.

findings.claim: Training-data contamination / license.
findings.evidence: `git diff a4d2851 HEAD -- packages/models/ packages/training/` => empty; smoke cases are hand-written synthetic strings in scripts/eval_jev_context.py.
findings.conclusion: N/A. No training, evaluation-data, or model change.

findings.claim: Reproducibility.
findings.evidence: `uv build` succeeds; wheel contains pleno_presidio_extras/{__init__,jev}.py only; `uv lock --check` matches HEAD commit; the one unpinned live smoke is documented as requiring a pin.
findings.conclusion: No problem. Lock matches HEAD; no statistical claim depends on re-running the live API.

findings.claim: Metric or benchmark exaggeration.
findings.evidence: README:73-74,86-87; sdk-0.3.0-jev-smoke.json:2 'not a held-out NER benchmark or evidence of production accuracy/calibration'.
findings.conclusion: No exaggeration. The default threshold is explicitly uncalibrated and no removal-rate or accuracy guarantee is claimed.

findings.claim: Hidden regression (threshold/aggregation/evaluation logic altered by the move; evidence tampering).
findings.evidence: Moved src/test/eval diffs are logger name and import path only; `_valid_answer`/`keep` logic is identical to sdk/v0.3.0; `git diff a4d2851 HEAD -- packages/training/experiments/artifacts/release-gate/` => empty; CI run 35553276330 all green; 106 passed.
findings.conclusion: No hidden regression. Aggregation, threshold, and fail-retain semantics are byte-identical; no model/training/log/benchmark/evidence diff.

findings.claim: The release does not train on or derive from the eval-only ai4privacy/pii-masking-300k license.
findings.evidence: `git show 1873267 --name-only` contains no packages/training or packages/models path; `git diff --quiet 1873267^ 1873267 -- packages/models/versions.json packages/training/experiments/log.jsonl packages/training/experiments/best.json packages/training/data packages/training/src` => exit 0; no dataset/train/HF references in the package; `uv build` wheel contains only the module and dist-info.
findings.conclusion: No problem. No training, fine-tuning, or derived-model generation; the dataset is neither trained on nor evaluated; the distribution contains no eval-data content.

findings.claim: Apache-2.0 redistribution includes the license text.
findings.evidence: `tar tzf .../pleno_presidio_extras-0.1.0.tar.gz | grep -i license` => none; wheel METADATA declares `License: Apache-2.0`; repo-root LICENSE exists.
findings.conclusion: Minor. Apache-2.0 section 4 asks for the license copy on redistribution and the wheel/sdist omit it. Not a data-contamination or eval-license violation and not a blocker; inclusion is desirable. Repo-wide (the SDK wheel/sdist have the same gap), deferred.

findings.claim: Smoke results are not presented as benchmark accuracy/F1; character-IoU span matching is not relabelled as unconditional F1.
findings.evidence: All F1/IoU/precision/recall/accuracy/benchmark matches in packages/presidio-extras are disclaimers (README:73-74, README:87, scripts/eval_jev_context.py:1,135); README quotes no removal rate; documented parameters match jev.py (context_chars 160, min_confidence 0.9, timeout 10.0, span>2048 kept, batch 8, (0.5,1]); the endpoint matches jev.py:191; the top-level README F1 lines are unchanged by this commit and their metric definition is documented.
findings.conclusion: No exaggeration in scope. The package README/script/artifacts claim no accuracy, F1, or benchmark, mark the threshold uncalibrated, and state the smoke is not a benchmark.

findings.claim: log.jsonl metrics_after cross-check.
findings.evidence: `git diff --quiet 1873267^ 1873267 -- packages/training/experiments/log.jsonl packages/training/experiments/best.json` => exit 0.
findings.conclusion: N/A. No model-metric claim and no experiment id (reproducibility lens scope).

findings.claim: Baseline comparison validity.
findings.evidence: packages/models/versions.json and _models.py unchanged; no dataset/split/engine before-after comparison.
findings.conclusion: N/A. Pure move with no before/after to compare.

findings.claim: Statistical significance (n=300 F1 delta).
findings.evidence: No F1-delta claim; the only quantitative artifact is an n=15 synthetic candidate smoke with 2/6 vs 3/6 removal across runs.
findings.conclusion: N/A. No precision/recall improvement claim; the run-to-run instability is consistent with the README's non-guarantee wording.

findings.claim: Reproducibility (log schema / data_hash / config).
findings.evidence: No new intervention in log.jsonl; `pytest packages/presidio-extras/tests -q` => 43 passed.
findings.conclusion: N/A (reproducibility lens scope). No model-experiment reproducibility record is due.

findings.claim: Per-label recall floor / latency regression concealment.
findings.evidence: No NER model or recognizer change; presidio-extras is an opt-in post-filter that preserves Presidio scores (jev.py changes no score, only removal decisions).
findings.conclusion: N/A. No model change and no improvement claim that could mask a per-label regression.

findings.claim: The README no longer claims the live smoke test is reproducible.
findings.evidence: commit bc072cc diff replaces the pin sentence with 'Pin a supported model ID to avoid model-version drift; results still vary between runs (see the smoke test below).'; `grep -rn -i reproduc packages/presidio-extras` => 0 matches; built wheel METADATA also has 0; README:82-85 states non-determinism.
findings.conclusion: No problem. No residual overclaim; README matches the observed run-to-run variance.

findings.claim: The 'results vary between runs' statement holds even with a pinned model, and supporting artifacts exist.
findings.evidence: sdk-0.3.0-jev-smoke.json resolved model jev-1.13.0 with false_positives_removed=2; sdk-0.3.0-jev-batch-smoke.json requested jev-1.13.0 with false_positives_removed=3; same resolved model, different removal counts.
findings.conclusion: No problem. The non-determinism statement is supported; removing the 'reproducible' claim was correct.

findings.claim: Wheel/sdist build reproducibility.
findings.evidence: `uv build` run twice: wheel and sdist sha256 identical across runs; sdist contents stable.
findings.conclusion: No problem. Byte-for-byte reproducible.

findings.claim: tag presidio-extras/v0.1.0 matches pyproject version and the release workflow validates it.
findings.evidence: pyproject.toml:2 version 0.1.0; release-presidio-extras.yml:18 trigger 'presidio-extras/v*' and :61-76 compares tag_version to pyproject; simulated REF_NAME=presidio-extras/v0.1.0 => 0.1.0 MATCH; `git tag -l 'presidio-extras/*'` empty.
findings.conclusion: No problem. The workflow fails closed on any version mismatch.

findings.claim: Test counts and CI coverage.
findings.evidence: `pytest packages/presidio-extras/tests -q` => 43 passed; ci.yml extras job runs ruff + pytest; `ruff check`/`format --check` pass.
findings.conclusion: No problem. 43 unit+integration tests green.

findings.claim: sdist ships the repo-root .gitignore and no LICENSE.
findings.evidence: sdist contains .gitignore (101 lines, identical to repo root) and no LICENSE; the same holds for the SDK build; pyproject uses `license = { text = "Apache-2.0" }`.
findings.conclusion: No problem for release (not introduced by this PR; pre-existing repo-wide hatchling behaviour). Deferred as minor; does not affect reproducibility.

revision_history.finding: PR #362 removed the published SDK module pleno_anonymize/presidio.py at an unchanged version 0.3.0, hiding a backward-incompatible change.
revision_history.resolution: PR #363 bumped packages/sdk to 0.4.0 and documented the removal and replacement import path in the SDK README. No shim (the API shipped only in 0.3.0 two days earlier). Re-reviewed APPROVE.

revision_history.finding: The README called the live smoke test reproducible, but the API is non-deterministic (confidences and removal counts vary; a transient unavailable answer fails the script's own gate).
revision_history.resolution: PR #364 removed the 'reproducible' claim, pinned the example model, and documented the variance and transient failure. The historical sdk-0.3.0 smoke artifact was deliberately not rewritten. Re-reviewed APPROVE.

revision_history.finding: A residual 'reproducible' remained in the model-pinning sentence (README:75).
revision_history.resolution: Reworded to 'Pin a supported model ID to avoid model-version drift; results still vary between runs.' Re-reviewed APPROVE.

deferred: Apache-2.0 license text is not bundled in the wheel/sdist (repo-wide; the SDK has the same gap).
The monorepo-root .gitignore is included in the sdist (repo-wide hatchling behaviour).
build-system hatchling is unpinned in uv.lock, so the published artifact is not time-hermetic.
